skill_name: Design the architecture for an object detection system.
workflow: The architecture for an object detection system consists of two main components: a feature extractor and a predictor. The feature extractor is responsible for extracting the features of an image, such as color, intensity, location, shape, etc. The feature extractor can be a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network), which extracts the features from the image and passes them to the predictors. The predictor then uses a classifier, such as a Support Vector Machine, to identify the object from the feature
